title: Generics for Value Configuration (Runtime Over-Generics)
pattern: Using compile-time type parameters or const generics for parameters that are only known or configured at runtime.
why_bad: Prevents simple configuration updates at runtime, degrades compile times, and forces distinct type instantiations for different configuration values.
detection: Const generic parameters on structs that represent simple configuration values (like ports, timeouts, limits).
counterexample: Array sizes or matrix dimensions that must be checked at compile time.
fix: Pass configuration values as fields or parameters during struct initialization.
